behaviors.description: Update only foreign copy by architecture-free app name.
behaviors.preconditions: Both architectures installed at A and both advertise B.
behaviors.expected: Foreign advances to B; native remains A.

behaviors.description: Select apps and runtimes independently during updates.
behaviors.preconditions: Reference app and runtime each have A/B versions.
behaviors.expected: Each type selector changes selected kind to B and retains excluded kind at A.

behaviors.description: Update app with its runtime absent but available.
behaviors.preconditions: App installed without dependencies and B advertised.
behaviors.expected: App reaches B without installing its required runtime.

behaviors.description: Update two distinct apps and an updatable runtime without a ref selector.
behaviors.preconditions: Independent queries A/B repositories contain distinct commits for Query/test, QuerySecond/test and Query.Data/next; all three are installed at A.
behaviors.expected: A no-ref update advances both apps and the runtime to their exact independently prepared B commits, retaining the unchanged base runtime commit.

behaviors.description: Download B without deployment, then deploy without pulling.
behaviors.preconditions: A installed; B available; payload faults controllable.
behaviors.expected: Download leaves A installed; local deployment reaches B despite denied payloads.

behaviors.description: Downgrade B to explicitly selected A.
behaviors.expected: A installed while remote tip remains B.

behaviors.description: Mask an installed ref then remove its mask.
behaviors.expected: Stored mask blocks B; removal clears enumeration and permits B.

behaviors.description: List pending remote updates before and after deployment.
behaviors.preconditions: A app and unchanged runtime installed; B advertised.
behaviors.expected: Only app listed before update; no refs afterward.

mappings.rationale: Both copies have updates but only selected copy advances.

surface_assertions.rationale: Foreign reaches B while native remains A despite available B.

mappings.rationale: App and runtime each have independently prepared updates.

surface_assertions.rationale: Runtime advances to B while app with available B stays A.
App advances to B while runtime with available B stays A.

mappings.rationale: Absent required dependency remains absent after app update.

surface_assertions.rationale: App advances to B without installing available required runtime.

mappings.rationale: Three independently exported refs have verified distinct A/B commits. After installing both distinct apps and the runtime at A, a no-ref update must put every one at its exact B commit; the base runtime remains at its unchanged tip.

surface_assertions.rationale: Successful B download leaves exact installed commit A.
Before downloading B, no-pull retains local A despite advertised B; after explicit download it deploys local B.

mappings.rationale: Explicit commit downgrades installed B to A while remote-info still reports B.
Persisted mask holds A; removal clears mask listing and permits B.
Exact update set excludes unchanged runtime and becomes empty after deployment.
